label: Road Ahead
description: One ride field: the elevation profile of the road in front of you, with no route loaded. It guesses the road ahead from the one you're on, reads the roads from the Karoo's own offline map, and fetches elevation over Wi-Fi. Tap the field to step between 2, 5 and 10 km.
releaseNotes: The field now always shows the full distance: at a junction it carries on along the likeliest road, drawn dimmer past the first guess. A half-width tile is all graph, the line is bolder, and a flat road runs through the middle of the tile. Every change has a setting.
